title: A persistent desk bot for each section, under the newsroom editor bot
description: Ryan 11-02: each section's news desk has its own persistent bot and ongoing conversation. The newsroom-level editor bot coordinates with the desks and all Story conversations. Proposed, awaiting Ryan: the desk bot answers in its section's Story conversations, the editor bot watches everything and answers where addressed or where a Story has no section. A Story that changes section keeps its conversation and changes bot. Depends on each site's section list (epic PPY-0a285b; lists awaiting Ryan) and Chatticus epic chatticus-4b2417. Sections renamed or retired need a rule for their bot. Done: Gherkin scenarios and p.apyr.us docs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 11-02 decided: a Story in a section gets the section's editor agent as responder; a Story not yet in a section gets the top-level bot. The responder changes as the Story moves. Needs chatticus-3e9444.
